facts.fact: TechAfrica News (vendor copy) says the PPP signed in June 2025 makes Trident exclusive e-KYC provider, with SIM-card registration binding the SIM to a verified citizen record as a core use case to be deployed.
TechAfrica News (vendor copy) says the June 2025 PPP covers digital payments enablement through one-click e-KYC as a core use case to be deployed in phases.
TechAfrica News (vendor copy) says the June 2025 PPP covers single-sign-on access to e-government and business portals as a core use case, rolled out in phases.
